---
title: "Open Science in the Swedish Context 2026"
---

<br>

## Course Overview

<div class="lesson-overview">

<p><span class="fa-regular fa-bookmark"></span> <strong>Description</strong><br>
This interdisciplinary course is designed to equip academics with practical tools and strategies for integrating Open Science practices throughout the entire research lifecycle. Through interactive lectures, discussions with guest speakers, and hands-on activities, participants will explore key principles, methods, and applications of Open Science in research.<br></p>

<p>Participants will develop knowledge and practical skills to support Open Science practices in:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Research planning and study design</li>
  <li>Data collection, management, and analysis</li>
  <li>Publishing research findings and educational resources</li>
  <li>Sharing research data and other outputs for reuse</li>
  <li>Communicating research to the public and other stakeholders</li>
</ul>

<p><span class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left"></span> <strong>Prerequisites</strong><br>
To follow this course, participants should have basic knowledge of:<br>
1. Principles of scientific research and methodology<br>
2. How research outputs are typically disseminated, (e.g., journals, conferences etc.)<br>
3. The structure of the Swedish research system, including universities and funding bodies. 
</p>

<p><span class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></span> <strong>Learning Outcomes</strong><br>
1. Explain what Open Science is. Discuss the benefits and challenges that come with its implementation, specifically in the Swedish context<br>
2. Describe the most common Open Science practices throughout every step of the research project lifecycle<br>
3. Implement Open Science practices into their own workflow</p>

<p><span class="fa-solid fa-users"></span> <strong>Target Audience:</strong> PhD students, postdocs, researchers, PIs and other employees at all Swedish universities</p>

<p><span class="fa-solid fa-unlock"></span> <strong>License:</strong> All course material will be made available under a 
<a href="https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/">CC BY 4.0</a> license following the conclusion of the course.</p>

</div>
